applicableAreas: Site Plan Approval Block, Cover Sheet
findings.comment: The approval block lacks the required 'DDZ' (Desired Development Zone) designation. The site is located in West Bouldin Creek Watershed, classified as Urban, which places it in the Desired Development Zone per LDC § 25-1-21(29). The approval block must include and clearly identify the DDZ designation.

applicableAreas: Non-cover plan sheets throughout the set

documentReferences.label: Master Comment Report - Case Manager Review

findings.comment: Multiple non-cover sheets (Sheets 2, 9, 12 verified; others not individually examined) do not reserve a blank space in the lower right corner for batch stamping. The required space is minimum 3.5" × 5" (or 1" × 1" as an acceptable alternative). Case Manager Comment CM 10 (dated U1) confirms this requirement remains uncleared, with notation that 'an undefined area is provided on some sheets but these areas need to be on all pages.' Full approval blocks and other content must be removed from the batch-stamp area to ensure space is reserved for City use.

applicableAreas: Site Plan Approval Block, Cover Sheet
findings.comment: The approval block contains unchecked checkboxes for 'ADMINISTRATIVELY' and 'BY COMMISSION' approval. The project qualifies for administrative (Director) approval per LDC § 25-5-112 and requires no Land Use Commission action. The 'ADMINISTRATIVELY' checkbox must be checked to indicate the correct approval basis, and the section reference must clearly cite LDC § 25-5-112 only.

applicableAreas: Site Plan Approval Block, Cover Sheet
findings.comment: The approval block contains the prohibited text 'RELEASED FOR GENERAL COMPLIANCE' followed by a blank signature line. This language must be removed from the approval block entirely.
